race.comment: Looks a competitive affair. The well-related MIMI'S (7) (half to G2 winner and G1 placed King's Gambit) is a former NSW galloper who got the job done at Eagle Farm first-up for the new stable and will have taken a bunch of confidence from that victory. Winning hoop Marshall sticks in the irons and can go back-to-back to start the campaign. VANESSI (11) doesn't win out of turn but will strip fitter second-up from the break and must be respected out of the champion Waller yard. Looms as the main danger. ERIMAR (12) just missed the frame when resuming and will have come on with that run now in the locker. Include with the 3kg claim. CRYPTIC BEAUTY (13) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Can feature while fresh. DYAMI (1) next best from the inside marble.
